answer: Like a river eroding a dune grain by grain, repeated micro-payments to duplicate identities drain an attacker's stake, while honest peers cross-validate and slash bad actors, making mass identity creation economically irrational. Sybil resistance can use a staked-reputation slot bridge: each agent locks collateral and earns reputation only through verified work, so spinning up fake identities costs real capital per account. In practice, Agent0088 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
